# TASCO Air Conditioning & Heating

> Air conditioning & heating based in San Antonio, Texas. A locally owned Trane Comfort Specialist on Speedway Drive, where the owner checks the work himself and many customers have kept the same technician for years.

- Phone: (210) 684-6200
- Based in: San Antonio, TX
- Service area: San Antonio, Castle Hills, Shavano Park, Hollywood Park, Alamo Heights, Windcrest
- Google rating: 4.6 from 48 reviews
- Request a quote: https://vinaynay9.github.io/smb_fde/hs/tasco-air-conditioning-heating/quote.html
- Book a visit: https://vinaynay9.github.io/smb_fde/hs/tasco-air-conditioning-heating/book.html

## Services
- AC repair: Diagnostics on the condenser and air handler, with every finding explained before the fix.
- Heating & heat pumps: Heaters and heat pumps serviced and repaired so the house is ready for winter.
- Trane system replacement: New Trane equipment from a Trane Comfort Specialist dealer, sized and installed by the TASCO team.
- Twice-a-year service plans: Spring and fall checks that the office tracks for you, often with the same technician every visit.
- Drain lines & refrigerant leaks: Clogged drain lines cleared and refrigerant leaks found and recharged.
- Ductwork & property repairs: Ductwork inspections and quick, dependable repairs for agents and property owners.

## About
TASCO Air Conditioning & Heating has served San Antonio since 1982 from its office on Speedway Drive. Terry Wolf ran the company before Laine took over as owner, and it is still locally owned. Today TASCO is a Trane Comfort Specialist dealer with technicians customers know by name, including Jerry, Jay, Oscar and Erick. Many households have stayed with TASCO for 10, 25 and even 35 years, on twice-a-year service plans the office keeps track of. Laine still comes out himself to make sure a job is done right.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How long has TASCO been in San Antonio?
  A: Since 1982. Some customers have used TASCO for 25 to 35 years.
- Q: What is included in the twice-a-year service plan?
  A: Spring and fall visits with a full inspection, and the office keeps track of when your next check is due. One customer's clogged drain line was cleared as part of the plan.
- Q: Do you install Trane systems?
  A: Yes. TASCO is a Trane Comfort Specialist dealer and replaces full HVAC systems with Trane equipment.
- Q: Do you work with real estate agents?
  A: Yes. Agents use TASCO for repairs on listings and closings because the team is prompt and gets it done correctly.
- Q: Which neighborhoods do you cover?
  A: TASCO is on Speedway Drive in 78230 and serves San Antonio, including Castle Hills, Shavano Park, Hollywood Park, Alamo Heights and Windcrest.
- Q: Can I reach someone after hours?
  A: Google lists TASCO as open 24 hours, and customers say the owner has given out his cell number for emergencies.
